run_pump_code_generation: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate C++ boilerplate code with variable substitution
parse_pump_ast: parse a Pump source text into an AST using ParseToAST for template meta programming
convert_pump_source: convert Pump source text to generated output code using ConvertFromPumpSource with variable expansion
tokenize_pump_template: tokenize a Pump template string into tokens using the Tokenize generator for parsing
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated code output by wrapping long lines to 80 characters using BeautifyCode
